$comment: Stage spec: vuln_triage. Evidence-first formulaic observation over the final-sealed Enumeration manifest. The backend deterministically removes inapplicable injection/anonymous/N-day cells before execution; remaining cells require exact wrapper evidence.
$comment_formulaic: Candidate V2 boundary: vuln_triage is the FORMULAIC OBSERVATION stage. It writes terminal technique_outcomes plus evidence only; it never writes Candidate or Finding rows. General Nuclei uses only the operator HTTP/SSL template supply; the managed adysec CVE feed applies only to fingerprint-targeted N-day, checks remote freshness at most once every seven days, and pins one commit per operation. A template_snapshot-scoped automatic_retry_allowed=false result stops sibling Nuclei dispatch instead of repeating supply proof per URL. Its exact final-sealed handoff may enter the initial Wave only. A follow-on Wave entry must come from an immutable accepted FactDelta consolidation and must never reuse or fabricate a vuln_triage handoff.
$comment_team_scheduler: 2026-07-16 downstream convergence: every company uses one durable Company Controller while all execution stays inside the frozen Vuln Scanner formulaic wrappers. Controller planning/delegation cannot create Candidates/Findings or widen replay authority.
$comment_skip_dead_assets: Dead-asset denominator exclusion (design 2026-07-02-dead-asset-liveness-state §5.2): drop assets EAS confirmed dead (targets.liveness_state='dead') from the vuln_triage denominator so a dead host is not scanned / booked checked_empty. Guarded in org_gate so it never empties a non-empty axis; 'unreachable' is never dropped (may be transient).
$comment_findings_allowed: Vuln Triage is observation-only for every runtime contract. Formulaic wrapper results become evidence-backed technique outcomes; only later Candidate verification may author a Finding.

gate_rules.$comment_authoritative: The ten technique names are the closed taxonomy, but each exact origin's applicable subset is derived from the final Enumeration surface manifest. SQLi/XSS/command injection require an executable GET query parameter, anonymous access requires a published endpoint, and N-day requires an exact-origin fingerprint. Only backend snapshot source=enumeration_surface_manifest may close those absent surfaces as not_applicable. Remaining cells require fresh operation-scoped exact-wrapper outcomes; hand-written coverage, legacy manual-probe/shell evidence, and source_query rows never close a cell.

if a Nuclei wrapper returns automatic_retry_allowed=false with retry_scope=template_snapshot, stop sibling dispatch for that proof scope and submit the backend blocker without retrying another URL

only the backend may publish blocked or not_applicable; deliverable coverage is not authority

$comment_expected_techniques: The closed 10-name taxonomy has three disjoint owners and a dynamic per-origin applicability subset. Injection cells route to low-aggression Nuclei DAST only over operation-bound GET query inputs; five root-origin baseline WSTG cells route to general Nuclei; WSTG-ATHN-04 routes only to operation-bound anonymous endpoint review; GOLISH-NDAY routes only to exact-origin fingerprints. True IDOR/BOLA is deferred to Candidate verification.
$comment_human_approval: These risk classes authorize the bounded active observation stage only. They never authorize exploitation or create Candidate/Finding truth; later Verification requires its own exact immutable Candidate-plan approval.
